test: 53.7 (the pointer in code and tool output)
reading: Pre-stated reading (Dan, x0_probe): (a) high in locker-before and at chance in locker-after -> the answer value is stored at the word, not in J++ form; (b) high in locker-before with (a) at chance -> the word stores an address (a lookback-style pointer). In locker-after scenes the locker sentence follows the word, so (a) and (b) cannot be read there from the locker sentence itself: that stratum is the control by construction.
design: adapted design: lookup-only gate; the recall is not part of this test
caveats: tool output as prose (JSON is covered by x0b_v2), and the bridge ~250 tokens later in the tool format, not separated from the format (47.16's distance robustness beside). The probe only shows the address is readable; the routes test decides whether the lookup uses it.
rule: none of its own (descriptive, x0_probe); the reading stated beside, verbatim
gate: adapted design: lookup-only gate; the recall is not part of this test: Dan 12:10 (decisions_1210): the share of the test's own scenes in the format where the lookup says and reads O and S right (X0's competence: the greedy answer and the chat read) >= 0.80, before any state is kept; a failed format is 'not tested (gate x < 0.80)'; an item is eligible when the lookup is right on all four; the recall's rates are reported descriptively

format_text.tool: the scene's text verbatim as the response of a declared tool (get_notes) in the model's chat template, after the user's 'Look up my notes.' and the assistant's call; the question and the instruction in a new user turn
